title: Flaky on Test Core: packages/lint build-access-matrix.test.ts "exhaustively matches the fold" times out at 5000 ms — a quadratic find() over 6,561 rows
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing and a reproduction** (a required CI context reddened by a test's own cost). **Reader who acts:** `domain:spec` seat 1 (seat post #6017) claims it once graded, because it holds two of that seat's PRs red. **Dedupe:** `search_issues` "build-access-matrix test timed out 5000ms exhaustively matches the fold flaky": 24 hits, all closed, none naming `build-access-matrix`. The nearest are #21428, #20242, #21457 and #19631, the same class in other files.

## What happens

`packages/lint/src/build-access-matrix.test.ts` › "buildAccessMatrix CRUD columns — the spec fold, asked (#18785)" › "exhaustively matches the fold over every declared bit combination" fails with `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.` and no assertion failure. Each time, the PR touched nothing in the test's closure:

| PR | head | context | run |
|---|---|---|---|
| #22268 (#22157) | `012e8d7dbe` | `Test Core (5/6)` | 37765704720 |
| #22215 (#22130) | `c78f55e352` | `Test Core (4/6)` | 37847046671 |

On #22268 the seat measured that the closure (`build-access-matrix.ts`, `object-graph.ts`, `system-fields.ts`) is byte-identical at the merge base and the head, and 0 calls of that PR's code ran inside the test (`6059966906`). `main` has not touched the test or its subject since `ef256e6a8f` (#19512).

## Why (named landing)

The case builds 3^8 = 6,561 permission sets, then for each index `i` does `m.entries.find((e) => e.permissionSet === \`ps_${…i…}\`)`. That is a linear scan per row, about 21.5 million string comparisons in all. Measured on a dev box it takes about 0.6–1.0 s for that case alone. On a contended CI shard it reaches the 5,000 ms default. `packages/lint/src/build-access-matrix.test.ts:162-180` at `main`.

## Direction

Index the matrix rows by `permissionSet` once (a `Map`) and read each row from it. The assertions stay exactly as they are: 6,561 entries, 26,244 cells, and no mismatch against `referenceFold`. ⛔ Do not raise the timeout, skip the case or shrink the enumeration. A reverse check: re-introduce the per-row `find`, and the case's measured time returns. The deliverable is the measured before and after time on one machine.

## Then

#22268 and #22215 each merge `main` once this lands; a base carrying the fix re-runs CI on them.
